credits.title: Mutter: The Diary of a Mother
credits.overview: On the fog-drenched Black Sea coast, a woman gives birth to a being that defies nature. As her body and mind begin to unravel, love becomes both her devotion and her disease.

credits.title: Neandria
credits.overview: Suna is a teenage athlete who lives with her mother in a mountain village much like the world at large: here, things are run by older men who know it all, environmental destruction looms, and greed beats in most hearts.

credits.title: The Criminals
credits.overview: Late at night in a small Turkish town, a young couple tries to find a hotel room to spend the night together. They are rejected from all hotels for not having a marriage certificate. Once they believe they’ve found a trick to use, the situation gets out of hand.

credits.title: Kader Postası
credits.overview: A film by Elif Akarsu Polat and Cigdem Bozali.

credits.title: A Hard Day in the Empire
credits.overview: An art department assistant desperately tries to make the director happy on a challenging day at the set of an Ottoman soap opera.

credits.title: Non-Transferable
credits.overview: Amy Tyler has planned the perfect surprise vacation for her boyfriend Josh Merit. But the real surprise is on her when he breaks things off on their anniversary. Stuck with reservations in her ex-boyfriend's name, Amy's two best friends suggest if Amy can't change the tickets ... why not change the guy?

credits.title: Fatih'in Fedaisi Kara Murat
credits.overview: Kara Murat is a dark-haired, brave and strong young raider. He is a warrior who could run into the Byzantine army just by himself and change the course of the battle fought in Serbia between Ottoman and Byzantine empires. He patrols the Ottoman borders along with the raiders and catches the attention of The Byzantine.

credits.title: Can
credits.overview: Loving Istanbul couple Ayşe and Cemal need only a child to complete their life together, but they cannot conceive. To salvage Cemal’s pride, they resort to illegal means to procure a baby. This wild grab at a more perfect life proves their undoing, leading the couple to spiral toward separate futures.
